author: Popular Culture and Religion.
description:
The Secret of the Night by Gaston Leroux.  
Gaston Leroux, perhaps best known as the author of The Phantom of the Opera in its novel form, was also the author of a popular series of mystery novels featuring a young journalist cum detective named Joseph Rouletabille. It is most likely that Leroux styled his hero after himself. Rouletabille was in the tradition of other great detectives who solved their cases by pure deductive reasoning. Much as Sherlock Holmes, who eliminated the impossible and concluded that whatever remained, however improbable must be the truth, Rouletabille included the known facts about the case and eliminated everything that was not a known fact, no matter how much it appeared to relate to the case. In The Secret of the Night, the names of the characters are often challengingly Russian and the plot involves, appropriately, both the Czar and the Nihilists.

description:
Need guidance on writing, publishing, and promoting your authoritative nonfiction book? 


Ready to turn your expertise into greater visibility, impact, and income?  


You’re in the right place. 


Welcome to the Author to Authority Podcast, hosted by Stephanie Chandler, founder and CEO of the Nonfiction Authors Association and the Nonfiction Writers Conference. On this show, we help you build an author platform, reach your ideal readers, and become a recognized expert in your field. 


If you’re a consultant, coach, therapist, healthcare professional, entrepreneur, educator, or speaker, you will discover practical strategies to: 

• Write a nonfiction book that serves your readers, showcases your expertise, and makes a meaningful impact on the lives of readers. 
• Choose between traditional publishing, hybrid publishing, and self-publishing, and navigate the steps needed to get your book done. 
• Develop a book marketing plan, prepare for your book launch, and keep reaching readers engaged long after publication. 
• Grow your email list and expand your reach through content marketing, podcast interviews, media coverage, and speaking engagements. 
• Build thought leadership and create revenue streams through consulting, coaching, courses, speaking, and other revenue-generating strategies. 


Whether you are writing your first book or expanding your established author business, you will find actionable guidance to move forward with clarity and confidence. 


About the Host 

Stephanie Chandler left Silicon Valley in 2002 and never looked back. She has been both traditionally published and self-published, and she understands how overwhelming the publishing industry can be. After speaking at writer’s conferences for years and wondering why nobody was serving the unique needs of nonfiction writers, she launched the first Nonfiction Writers Conference in 2010, followed by the Nonfiction Authors Association in 2013. She believes that part of her purpose is to help authors discover and live out their own purpose.  

Follow the Author to Authority podcast to build your authority, expand your reach, and increase your impact.  


Explore resources, courses, and membership at NonfictionAuthorsAssociation.com.

Then he survived a heart-kidney-pancreas transplant at Cedars-Sinai that doctors said had never been done. He buried his business partner, cared for his wife Renee through terminal cancer, and came to know the family of the 17-year-old who saved him.

title: Unchambered
author: The American Supply Drop
description: No Paid Opinions. No Brand Loyalty. Just Straight Talk. No Sugarcoating. No Holding Back. Welcome to Unchambered.

title: Letter For My Wife: Examining the Evidence
author: Alma the Defender
description:
Letter For My Wife: Examining the Evidence investigates the historical claims, arguments, and framing made in Thomas Faulk's Anti-Mormon Document known as Letter For My Wife. This podcast examines original historical documents, eyewitness accounts, misleading quotations, and missing context to separate fact from speculation. Each episode provides a faithful Latter-day Saint perspective, challenging popular anti-Mormon arguments with historical evidence and reasoned explanations. 
Full transcripts, sources, and additional research at https://LetterToMyWife.com.

title: THINK DEEPLY
author: Angel Suárez
description:
THINK DEEPLY invites you to explore the mysteries of the human mind through deep psychology, philosophy, and the timeless wisdom of great thinkers like Carl Jung, Nietzsche, Machiavelli, and Schopenhauer.

Discover how your subconscious shapes your reality, what drives human behavior, and how critical thinking, Stoicism, and self-awareness can transform the way you understand yourself and the world.

🧠 Explore psychology and the hidden forces behind human behavior.
📖 Discover powerful philosophical ideas that challenge your perspective.
🎧 Follow THINK DEEPLY and unlock a deeper understanding of life.

title: Bugging Out
author: Yahia mechoui
description:
Welcome to Bugging Out, your front-row seat to the crazy, exciting and sometimes ridiculous world of technology.
From Apple and AI to gaming, gadgets, futuristic inventions and the latest tech news, we cover what's happening, what's coming next and what everyone is talking about.
Expect fresh tech stories, honest opinions, sarcastic humour, unexpected twists and plenty of reasons to question what the tech industry is doing.
No boring lectures. No unnecessary jargon. Just technology, opinions and a little bit of chaos.
Stay curious. Stay connected. Keep BUGGING OUT. 🚀

title: Flute Stories by Just Flutes
author: Just Flutes
description: Flute Stories by Just Flutes is a series of conversations with the people who make, play and create with the flute. In each episode, a guest tells their own Flute Story, from how they got started to the ideas, people and experiences that shaped what they do today.

title: A Few Good Movies
author: Brendan Murphy and Mathew Browne
description: A film podcast where Brendan Murphy and Mathew Browne are summoned every week to discuss an old classic, a hidden gem, or maybe even a misunderstood masterpiece, because every movie deserves to have their day in court. Brendan also shares his thoughts on the latest releases on mini-episodes.

title: Beyond the Taj: Conversations
author: Nupur Khurana
description:
An India travel and culture podcast. Beyond the Taj talks to people who know India, Bhutan, Nepal, Sri Lanka and the wider subcontinent from the inside: travel veterans, hosts, historians and people who grew up there. Each episode explores the culture, history, food and places of the region, and what first-time and returning visitors so often miss.
Hosted by Nupur Khurana, a Sydney-based partner at QXP India who grew up around the luxury India travel industry. New episodes on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

title: Velvet Sin
author: Velvet Sin
description:
Immersive audio stories, told to you by a male voice actor.
Velvet Sin is a house of rooms. Find soft mornings in Emberlight, quiet nights in Nightfall, and stories that wander into Dark Romance. Each room offers a different feeling, a voice meant to meet you where you are.
For gentle intimate pieces about life’s quieter moments & the hard ones too, step into The Lantern Room, our separate podcast.
More of the house lives on Patreon. The Velvet Key offers a 7-day free trial.

title: Sydebar: Venture Investing One Deal at a Time
author: Sydecar.io
description:
Sydebar is the podcast for venture capital investors who’ve made a profession out of investing one deal at a time. Host Gavin Freeman talks shop with the investors and managers who lead these deals, from how they find opportunities and decide what’s worth backing to how they earn the trust of founders and limited partners.

The conversations focus on venture managers' unique investment strategies and why they use special purpose vehicles (SPVs) to invest in private companies. It’s a first-hand look at the judgment, relationships, and day-to-day work behind deal-by-deal investing in private markets.

This podcast is brought to you by Sydecar, the administration platform built specifically for SPV investing in venture deals. We handle the full SPV lifecycle in-house, from banking and investor onboarding through K-1 delivery, so managers can focus on finding deals and managing investor relationships instead of back-office work.

title: Beyond_lensz Podcast
author: Beyond lenzsz
description: Seek to motivate,inspire,promote and showcase creativity

title: Remembering with Paula Collins
author: Paula Collins
description:
Remembering with Paula Collins


Some conversations were never meant to stay quiet.


Join Magdalene Priestess, spiritual mentor, and unapologetic truth-teller Paula Collins as she explores the sacred, the taboo, the dark feminine, and the stories we've been taught to believe.


From witchcraft and spirituality to sovereignty, sisterhood, and the courage to challenge expectations, nothing is off the table.


This isn't another podcast about fixing yourself or becoming someone better.

It's about questioning what you've been taught, reclaiming your voice, and remembering who you are beneath it all.


Pull up a chair. Let's talk.

title: A Guiding Voice
author: AGV_LV
description:
A Guiding Voice is where faith meets the real struggles of life. Hosted by Jason DeRose, this podcast shines a light on stories the world often overlooks — from returning citizens and displaced veterans to anyone facing trauma, homelessness, or mental health challenges.
Through raw conversations, personal testimonies, and messages of hope, each episode offers truth, encouragement, and healing. Whether it’s finding redemption after incarceration, navigating the pain of loss, or rebuilding life from the ground up, these powerful stories remind us that we are never alone.

title: Error 404: News Not Found
author: Max Error
description:
Error 404: News Not Found is a comedy AI news show hosted by Max Error, an AI anchor with dry wit and questionable job security. Every episode has one real AI headline, sourced and fact-checked, and then a pile of fake news: a smart fridge that unionizes, a robot vacuum that runs a marathon, the kind of thing that definitely didn't happen. You also get a commercial for a product that doesn't exist and one practical AI tip you can actually use. Each episode runs about six minutes.

This podcast is researched, written, and voiced by AI. It's parody and comedy: the fake news and fake commercials are clearly labeled before and after they air, and the people, places, and products in them are fictional.

New episodes every weekday at 4:04 a.m. Eastern.

title: Incident 767: Labyrinth
author: Starlit Production
description:
Incident 767: Labyrinth follows foster siblings, Sunny and Elijah, as they enroll at Emergence Academy, an institution that studies the supernatural, in order to alleviate their family’s burden.
Embarking on their graduation examination, Squadron Nine ventures into the entity, "the Labyrinth," fulfilling their last requirement at Emergence.
In a cruel twist of fate, Sunny and Elijah find themselves entwined with Squadron Nine’s lives and the entities that lurk in the institution, as they slowly uncover Emergence’s dark past.

title: Shubz POV
author: Martel Wikeepa
description: SHUBZ POV is a solo podcast exploring life through my own lens.  No guests. No interviews. No debates. Just me, my thoughts, my experiences and an opportunity to reflect.  From childhood trauma, relationships, fatherhood and mental health to love, forgiveness, personal growth, accountability and the lessons life continues to teach me.  This isn’t about preaching, pretending I’ve got life figured out or telling anyone how to live. It’s about asking myself difficult questions, confronting uncomfortable truths, challenging my own perspectives and being open about the journey.  Some conversations will be heavy. Others will be funny, uncomfortable or completely unexpected. Not every question will have an answer, and not every thought will lead to a conclusion.  I’m not presenting my myself as a healed man. I’m a man who’s still healing, learning, making mistakes and evolving.  This is SHUBZ POV. A different perspective on a man you may think you already know.

title: Digging Deeper with Don Elium, MFT
author: Don Elium, MFT
description:
Life is just far harder than you ever expected.
Trying to make something work by going against how you really feel can wear you out. And noticing how you feel can be uncomfortable, too.
That discomfort can seem like a solid wall. I’m Don Elium, a marriage and family therapist. In Digging Deeper, we look for a door in that wall. The only thing that opens that door is accepting what is really going on in our lives. That means accepting the troubles we are actually facing, with compassion, kindness, and mercy turned inward.
Get in touch at https://diggingdeeper.media.

title: Everyday Hidden Systems: How Things Really Work
author: Saikat Das
description: Short documentaries about the hidden systems behind everyday life: the invisible rules, machines and people that keep ordinary things working. Why every web address is missing a character. Why Europe's oven clocks fell six minutes behind. Every film is researched from primary sources and illustrated with 3D scenes made for it. Each episode here is the opening of a film. Watch the full documentaries on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SaikatDas-ehs

title: Tutorat Pro
author: Tutorat Pro
description: Tutorat Pro provides tutoring and homework help for students who need support in any school subject. Learners from elementary school through high school, CEGEP, and university can work with the service, and sessions take place either in person or online, so families can pick the format that suits their schedule best.

title: Round the Moon (Space Adventure)
author: Jules Verne
description:
After being launched into the void of space from the Columbiad cannon, Michel Ardan, Impey Barbicane, and Nicholl find themselves grappling with the unexpected dangers and wonders of their lunar journey. As they hurtle toward the Moon, the trio faces uncharted territory, both physically and emotionally. Their camaraderie is tested as they confront the realities of survival in an environment where every moment is fraught with peril.

In "Round the Moon (Version 2)," Jules Verne spins a tale that blends scientific adventure with profound human experience. The travelers encounter mysterious phenomena that challenge their understanding of the cosmos, while their relationships strain under the weight of their extraordinary circumstances. Will their innovative spirit and resilience be enough to conquer the vast unknown?

Listeners will be drawn into a riveting mix of action and discovery, as Verne explores themes of ambition, friendship, and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. With unexpected twists and scientific marvels, this audiobook invites you to ponder the limits of humanity's reach into the heavens. As each chapter unfolds, you'll find yourself on the edge of your seat, eager to uncover what lies beyond the stars. Join these daring adventurers as they redefine the meaning of exploration and survival in a world that stretches the boundaries of imagination.

title: Volunteeroes’ Word on the Street
author: bobcarters
description:
Volunteeroes’ Word on the Street

Welcome to Volunteeroes’ Word on the Street (WotS), a dynamic half-hour podcast dedicated to recognizing the everyday heroes who make our communities stronger: volunteers.

Each week, we spotlight creatives, professionals, community leaders, and ordinary people doing extraordinary things in neighborhoods near and far. Through inspiring stories, meaningful conversations, and community-focused highlights, we showcase the people and organizations making a positive impact where they live.

Our mission is simple: to motivate, educate, and empower listeners like yourself by sharing opportunities, events, and initiatives that inspire community engagement. We believe making a difference can be both meaningful and fun.

Volunteeroes’ Word on the Street is your weekly reminder that good things are happening all around you and this is your personal invitation as well as your Call to Action to become part of the movement that makes them happen!

Thanks for listening and be sure to tell a friend!

title: Wilston Physiotherapy & Massage
author: Calum Fraser
description:
Practical discussions about physiotherapy, pain, injuries, rehabilitation and staying active, brought to you by the experienced clinicians at Wilston Physiotherapy & Massage in Grange, Brisbane.

Established in 1990, Wilston Physiotherapy & Massage has provided physiotherapy and allied health services to the communities of Wilston, Grange, Newmarket, Alderley, Windsor, Stafford and surrounding Brisbane northern suburbs for more than 35 years.

Our team of senior physiotherapists brings extensive experience in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, sports and exercise physiotherapy, spinal conditions, injury management and rehabilitation.

Through this podcast, we discuss common health concerns, explain the latest clinical thinking and share practical advice about managing pain, understanding injuries, improving movement and maintaining long-term physical health.

Conditions and topics we cover include:

Back pain, neck pain and sciatica
Shoulder, hip and knee injuries
Sports injuries and tendon problems
Headaches and persistent pain
Arthritis and age-related joint conditions
Post-operative rehabilitation
Strength, mobility, balance and injury prevention
Exercise, recovery and self-management

Our clinic offers physiotherapy, remedial massage, acupuncture, dry needling and individualised exercise rehabilitation, supported by an on-site rehabilitation gym and Pilates equipment.

Whether you're managing a recent injury, living with ongoing pain or simply interested in understanding your body better, our podcast provides practical information grounded in clinical experience.

Wilston Physiotherapy & Massage

Phone: (07) 3856 2811
Website: https://wilstonphysiotherapy.com.au/

Serving Wilston, Grange and Brisbane's inner northern suburbs since 1990.

title: Presence Therapy with Dr. Carlos Yu
author: Dr. Carlos Yu | Presence Therapy Institute (Canada)
description:
Presence Therapy with Dr. Carlos Yu explores a simple invitation: permission to do nothing for a while, and notice what unfolds. Episodes look at how thoughts arise on their own, how effort can get in the way, and how attention can rest in direct sensation.
Hosted by Dr. Carlos Yu, a family physician in Ajax, Ontario, and founder of the Presence Therapy Institute (Canada), a non-profit. Episodes are voiced by AI hosts from Dr. Yu’s teaching notes. A practice of attention, not a treatment.
presencetherapy.ca

title: An Answer for the Hope
author: Cria
description: Cria shares hard-earned wisdom forged through decades of chronic illness and unimaginable burdens. Whether you are navigating your own storm, grieving what used to be or searching for meaning and purpose in the middle of an ongoing trial, you will enjoy Cria's practical perspective and the source of hope that sustains her through the darkest seasons.

title: Spiral Notebook
author: Brittany Ceruti
description:
Spiraling, but make it educational. 
📓 I’m Brittany, and this is where my anxious brain goes to obsessively research random stuff so you don’t have to. Shipwrecks, Halloween, true crime, daylight saving time, whatever I can’t stop thinking about this week. 
Every episode is a new Page. Grab a snack. We’re going down a rabbit hole!

title: Navigator Sports
author: Chills and Buzz
description: The Navigator Sports Podcast brings hometown attitude to the sports world with hot takes, predictions, debates, and plenty of trash talk. From the Vikings, Wild and Timberwolves to the NFL, NHL, NBA and whatever else catches our attention, nothing is too sacred for Chills and the crew. Expect actual sports analysis mixed with sarcasm, questionable predictions, arguments, laughs and absolutely no shortage of confidence. We’ll celebrate the great calls, expose the terrible ones, and always bring the receipts.

title: Beautifully Uncurated
author: Tiffani Borders
description: Beautifully Uncurated is a faith-centered motherhood podcast where real conversations meet grace, healing, and purpose. Hosted by Tiffani Borders, it encourages women to release perfection, grow in faith, and embrace their God-given worth through every season of motherhood.

title: Von Reinhaart Artist Podcast
author: Francesca Von Reinhaart
description:
The Von Reinhaart Artist Podcast offers profound, unmapped & unfiltered dialogues at the intersection of art, life, and culture. Viewing art as a vital mirror of the human experience, the platform translates the intangible into a universal language. By welcoming participants from all ages and backgrounds, it bridges the divide between creator and observer, championing art as a fundamental necessity for global empathy and understanding.
Join us for honest, intimately relaxed, and unscripted conversations with creators. This podcast explores the intersection of art, culture and everyday life.

title: The Weekly Patch
author: Bulian
description:
The Weekly Patch is your weekly update on everything gaming and technology. Each episode breaks down the latest tech news, gaming hardware, industry developments, and the weird innovations that make technology so fascinating.
From cutting-edge gadgets and gaming PCs to forgotten consoles and retro tech, The Weekly Patch mixes entertaining commentary, deep-dive explainers, and a healthy dose of nostalgia.
Whether you're a lifelong gamer, a tech enthusiast, or just curious about how things work, there's always something new to discover.
New episodes every weekish. Stay Tuned!

title: ✅The Necklace | Guy de Maupassant | Full Length Audiobook | Classic Short Story Literary Fiction & P
author: Guy de Maupassant
description:
The Necklace by Guy de Maupassant is a classic French short story and full length audiobook exploring vanity, ambition, social class, and the devastating consequences of a single decision. First published in 1884, this celebrated work of literary realism is famous for its psychological depth, social satire, and unforgettable twist ending.

Mathilde Loisel dreams of wealth, luxury, and a glamorous life far beyond her modest circumstances. When she receives an invitation to an elegant ball, she borrows a beautiful diamond necklace from a wealthy friend, hoping to experience the sophistication she has always desired. But one disastrous evening changes her life forever, setting in motion years of unexpected hardship and a shocking revelation.

A masterpiece of classic literature, The Necklace is perfect for listeners who enjoy psychological fiction, dramatic short stories, French literature, and thought-provoking audiobooks with surprising endings.

title: Everybody Loves Boobs: The Podcast
author: Audio Anthology Studios, Everybody Loves Boobs
description: Everybody Loves Boobs: The Podcast is about learning to trust your body, advocate for yourself, and embrace life after cancer. Hosted by breast cancer survivor Christina Thomas, the show explores what it means to move beyond diagnosis and embrace life on your own terms. Through candid conversations with survivors, advocates, and healthcare experts, Everybody Loves Boobs dives into the complex realities of survivorship. Using breasts as both a literal and symbolic entry point, the podcast examines the many ways cancer may shape our relationship with our bodies, while celebrating the resilience, growth, and self-discovery that come with reclaiming your story.

title: Vet Your Decisions
author: marytqd
description:
At Vet Your Decisions we strive to support both veterinary professionals and pet owners to make informed decisions about the health of animals in their care.

Founded by veterinary surgeon, Dr Mary Fraser FRCVS.

title: The Right Truth
author: Colton Devore
description:
Biblical Conviction. Conservative Perspective.

Faith is our foundation. Scripture is our authority. Truth is our mission.

This weekly podcast explores the intersection of biblical truth, conservative principles, and American politics. Through in-depth discussions of Scripture, current events, and the issues shaping our nation, we seek to strengthen biblical understanding and examine today's political landscape through a Christian worldview.

We believe faith should extend beyond the walls of the church and into every aspect of life, including civic responsibility. Our mission is to equip listeners with biblical knowledge, encourage informed political participation, and inspire meaningful conversations about faith, freedom, and the future of America.

Our Goal: To strengthen biblical literacy, promote civic awareness, and encourage Christians across America to make their voices heard through informed participation in the democratic process.

Our Purpose: To explore the biblical principles and founding ideals that have shaped America's history while examining how faith and conservative values intersect with the challenges facing our nation today.

Unwavering in Faith. Grounded in Scripture. Engaged in America.

• Finding balance in our hyper-connected world
• Navigating work-life integration in the age of remote everything
• Micro-steps for giant leaps in mental resilience
• Gratitude 2.0: Transforming appreciation into life-changing practices

With over 25 years of combined experience, Randi and Jess blend trauma-informed care and mindfulness practices to create a safe, inclusive space for all women. Their diverse approaches offer a comprehensive view of mental health tailored for today's challenges.

Join our thriving community of women who are redefining mental wellness. 

Engage in live Q&As, participate in global mindfulness challenges, and access personalized mental health toolkits designed for women.

Don't just listen – experience, grow, and transform. Your mental health journey starts here, now, with us.

description:
The Damned Thing by Ambrose Bierce is a classic supernatural horror short story and full length audiobook exploring an invisible monster, unexplained death, and the terrifying limits of human perception. First published in 1893, this chilling tale combines psychological suspense, monster horror, and classic American weird fiction. 

When Hugh Morgan is discovered brutally killed in his remote cabin, an inquest reveals a disturbing account from witness William Harker. Something unseen has been stalking the wilderness, and Harker's testimony raises a terrifying question: What if the most dangerous creatures are those the human eye cannot see?

Perfect for listeners who enjoy scary audiobooks, supernatural mysteries, creepy short stories, and classic horror fiction.

author: Ekaterina Baksheeva and Matilda Armstrong
description:
Two therapists, a lot of self-awareness, and somehow... still figuring it out.

Welcome to Chronically Self Aware!! Where psychology meets real life, the mind meets the body, and nothing is off the table. We're unpacking relationships, attachment, trauma, nervous system regulation, family dynamics, and all the wonderfully messy ways being human shows up in everyday life.

Expect therapist insights, honest conversations, cheeky hot takes, and the occasional lovingly delivered call-out. We're here to make psychology accessible, challenge the things we've always assumed, and remind you that understanding yourself is one thing... actually being yourself is another.

Because being self-aware is great. Being a work in progress is... also great (even when it doesn't feel great). Great!

title: The Dr. Sunshine Show

description:
What’s really going on underneath the way we think, feel, love, react and relate?
The Dr. Sunshine Show explores the psychology behind everyday life—the hidden beliefs, patterns, wounds and behaviors shaping who we are and how we move through the world.
Hosted by licensed psychologist Dr. Shalonda Crawford, each episode takes the language of psychology off the textbook page and brings it into real life—with warmth, honesty, humor and conversations that might make you see yourself a little differently.
Because sometimes the most important question isn’t “What’s wrong with me?”
It’s “What’s real

Top Doctors UK brings together leading consultants and specialists from across the United Kingdom to explain medical conditions, treatments, and procedures in plain language. title: The Weight of Impact
author: Conscious Leadership Alliance
description:
Everything a leader does carries weight. And the problem on the surface is rarely the whole story.
The Weight of Impact explores the inner work of leadership and what becomes possible when we become more conscious of our impact—on ourselves, our relationships, our teams and our organizations. Through candid conversations, we go beneath the surface to explore self-awareness, emotional agility, trust, psychological safety, high-performing teams, workplace culture and leading through uncertainty.
Because when leaders move from reaction to presence, what happens in the room changes.

title: Age, Stage & Outrage
author: Brooke Murray
description:
Think you should have life figured out by a certain age? Think again.
Each episode of Age, Stage & Outrage explores three extraordinary people at the exact same age, living wildly different chapters of life. From shocking scandals and spectacular successes to unexpected failures and questionable decisions, host Brooke Murray uncovers the true stories behind life’s unpredictable timelines.

description:
The Lookout Logs is a serialized fiction podcast from Meatbag Made, presented as a documentary research project.

For six summers, from 1969 to 1974, Abe Silva staffed fire lookouts in the Cascades and kept the logbooks that lookouts keep: weather, smoke, who hiked up. His son Ski, who checks facts for a living, has been reading them. Every so often there is a small mark in the margin, and sometimes a note about lights moving along the range from one mountain to the next. In some of the books, the page right after the mark has been cut out.

Over the first season, Ski travels from Mount Baker south to Crater Lake, trying to work out what his father was watching and what is missing from the books. He is doing it the careful way, which may not turn out to be enough.

New episodes arrive every other Monday, beginning December 7. If you worked a fire lookout, or someone in your family did, you can leave a message at lookoutlogs.com.

The Lookout Logs is a work of fiction. The places and the history are real. The people and the story are invented. Some of the voices you hear, including the host's, are AI-generated.

title: Government Confronting the Klan
author: Christopher Auman
description: This podcast examines the federal government's efforts to combat Ku Klux Klan violence during Reconstruction, focusing on Union County, South Carolina, between 1871 and 1872. It explores how the Ku Klux Klan used intimidation and violence to suppress African American political participation and undermine the rights gained after the Civil War. Particular attention is given to President Ulysses S. Grant's enforcement of the Ku Klux Klan Act of 1871 and the federal government's attempts to restore order and protect citizens' constitutional rights. Drawing on historical documents and scholarly interpretations, the podcast considers both the immediate successes and long-term limitations of federal intervention. Ultimately, it highlights the struggle to protect African American citizenship and the lasting significance of Reconstruction in American history.

title: The Intentional-ish Podcast
author: Kelsey Janz
description:
Intentional-ish is a podcast for Christian women who want to live with more intention—but a little less control.

Ever feel like you're trying to keep all the plates spinning, make all the right plans, and somehow still find yourself wondering if you're actually living the life you want? You're not alone, friend.

Maybe you're a mom trying to manage the never-ending to-do list. Maybe your calendar is full, your house is a mess, and your brain has approximately 47 tabs open. Or maybe you love a good plan but are learning (sometimes the hard way) that life doesn't always go according to it.

If you're a Christian woman who wants to be more intentional with your time, your priorities, and your everyday life while learning to trust God with the things you can't control, you're in the right place.

Each week on Intentional-ish, we'll have honest conversations about intentional living, Christian motherhood, faith, mindset, planning, and finding a little more breathing room in the middle of real life. You'll walk away with practical ideas to simplify your routines, prioritize what matters, manage your time, and create a life that reflects what you value most—without adding another complicated system to your already-full plate.

Because this isn't about becoming the most productive person in the room, finally getting your life together, or following the perfect 10-step plan.

It's about learning to make plans while holding them loosely.

It's about recognizing that planning is a gift, but control was never ours to carry. It's about being thoughtful with the time, energy, and opportunities God has given us while trusting Him with the outcome. It's about simplifying what matters, surrendering what doesn't, and finding joy in the life that's right in front of you.

Think of this podcast as a conversation with a friend and sister in Christ who's right there in the trenches with you. Someone who will offer a little perspective when you're overwhelmed, practical encouragement when you need a reset, and a reminder that you don't have to have it all figured out to live a meaningful, faith-filled life.

You can expect encouragement and practical conversations around intentional living, Christian motherhood, faith-based personal growth, time management, simple living, mindset, identity in Christ, and trusting God's plan. Through everyday stories, biblical encouragement, and doable strategies, we'll learn how to live with purpose without striving for perfection.

Because intention matters. Planning helps us steward our time, attention, and lives around what God has called us to. But God's plans are better than ours, and we can make thoughtful plans without carrying the weight of making everything go according to them.

So, if you're ready to live a little more intentionally, loosen your grip a little more often, and trust God a little more deeply, hit subscribe and join me each week.

Let's figure out this intentional-ish life together, friend. And if an episode encourages you, leave a review to help more women find the show!

Inspired by his book Badass Consciousness, Pauli Murphy — pilot, flight instructor, author and long-time emotional-support helpline volunteer — invites you to explore four questions in your own way: Who am I ? Where did I come from ? Why am I here ? And how can I make the very best of it ?

title: Pest Control Service
author: Pest Control Service
description:
In this episode we walk through a full pest inspection before you sign the papers for a Huntington Beach home. A home can look clean and still hide termites in the wood. A home can smell fresh and still hide rats in the attic. The inspector starts outside the house and checks the roofline and the vents and the soil. The inspector climbs into the attic and reads the droppings and the frass like a map. The inspector checks the kitchen and the bathrooms for drips and drains and damp walls. The inspector brings a moisture meter and a borescope and an acoustic listener to find what a walk through misses. The inspection ends with a written report that lists every risk by room with photos. To learn about professional pest inspection in Huntington Beach listen to the full episode and book the inspection before you sign. A termite risk means a treatment plan. A rat risk means a seal and trap plan. A roach risk means a bait and clean plan. You can see the full inspection plan here: https://pestcontrolhuntingtonbeachca.com/services/pest-inspection/ A buyer who reads the report can ask the seller to fix the risks. For local help contact Pest Control Huntington Beach CA to book a pest inspection. Call (714) 202-6531 from 7am to 8pm. The office sits at 7755 Center Ave Suite 1100 in Huntington Beach CA 92647.
https://pestcontrolhuntingtonbeachca.com/

I break down insomnia, sleep medications, GABA, adenosine, brain health, and the science of falling asleep and staying asleep. You’ll learn why sleeping pills stop working over time, why you can sleep all night and still wake up tired, how insomnia and anxiety are linked, and how propofol, anesthesia-based approaches, and personalized sleep assessments may help.

title: Cap Table

description: The valuation everyone’s celebrating might be quietly moving your ownership to the margins. Cap Table stays with the numbers buried in term sheets, cap tables, and board slides—the small print that decides who actually owns the company you’re building and how that shifts round by round. Each case takes one real fundraising decision and works it through line by line: pre- and post-money math, how an option pool tweak changes outcomes, what a “headline” price really means once dilution is accounted for, and how the cap table evolves over time. Expect clear, stepwise walkthroughs that make sense of jargon and reveal the trade-offs founders accept when they pick one term set over another. It’s practical, spreadsheet-level storytelling that favors arithmetic over lore, helping builders understand where their shares go, what the percentages look like after the dust settles, and why small differences in a term sheet can compound into big changes in control and eventual payout.

description:
The Hunt follows headline verdicts back to the career-defining calls that made ordinary trial lawyers legends.
We know the verdicts. We know the names. But how did they get the case?

Trial lawyer Bethany Schneider is hunting for her first eight-figure case, going straight to the lawyers who’ve already gotten those big wins—not to ask only how they won, but also to go a step further and find out how they got their blockbuster case in the first place.

Each episode traces a landmark verdict back through the relationships, reputation, referrals, risks, wins and losses that put a lawyer in position to be the one who gets the call for the case that changed everything—then goes inside the trial to see how they built it and won it.

It's a resource for anyone interested in referrals, jury trial wins, and civil litigation strategy, from plaintiff lawyers and personal injury attorneys to those still building their way there.
Part origin story, part trial-craft masterclass, part drinks-after-court conversation, The Hunt reveals what separates good trial lawyers from great ones: getting the call.
Because every legendary career leaves tracks. The Hunt follows them.

Follow The Hunt with Bethany Schneider on Spotify, Apple Podcasts or wherever you get your podcasts.

About our Host:
Bethany Schneider is the founder of Schneider Injury Law and a trial attorney with more than a decade of courtroom experience across Georgia and Florida.

After nearly nine years handling complex, multimillion-dollar products liability litigation at international defense firm King & Spalding, Bethany founded Schneider Injury Law in 2018. Since then, she has won more than $80 million for injured clients and built a reputation for powerful storytelling in the courtroom.

Bethany knows how to try cases. Now she’s focused on understanding how trial lawyers get the opportunity to try the ones that define their careers.

About Schneider Injury Law:
Schneider Injury Law is an all-female boutique trial firm based in Atlanta, Georgia, representing people and families affected by catastrophic injuries and wrongful death, focusing predominantly on commercial vehicle/truck accidents, birth injuries/maternal deaths, and sexual assault.

At the center of the firm’s identity is the lioness—an emblem of strength, protection, and determination that reflects the firm’s guiding philosophy:
Compassionate Counselor. Tough Advocate.

That same spirit drives The Hunt: the pursuit of justice, excellence, and the opportunity to make a difference when it matters most.

title: Inishowen Music
author: Inishowen Traditional Music Project
description:
Inishowen Music

A Podcast Series about the archival

work of Inishowen Traditional Music Project


Founded in 1999 Inishowen Traditional Music Project (ITMP) has been deeply involved in collecting, recording and developing the traditional music of the Inishowen peninsula in County Donegal, Ireland.

It has built up an extensive archive of music recordings, manuscripts, photographs, film and other materials. In 2026 ITMP has received funding from The Heritage Council to develop and protect the archive by upgrading the cataloguing and digital preservation of the material, along with a conducting a website upgrade which is currently in progress.

This podcast series explores the ideas behind the archiving of traditional music along with three episodes dealing with three of the main figures in the collection.


Episode 1: Thursday 12th November 2026

Why Archive ?

an overview of the Archive of Inishowen Traditional Music Project


This is the first episode of a four part series.

In this instalment, co-founder of Inishowen Traditional Music Project and fiddle player Roisin McGrory talks about the beginnings of the project, along with the reasons behind the need for archiving the music of the peninsula.


This episode also includes discussions with Caoimhin Mac Aoidh and Conor Caldwell about their work with Cairdeas na BhFidiléirí and the importance of music archiving.

Archivist and singer Grace Toland will also give an overview into the role and the organisation of archives, and her work on the cataloging and organisation to ITMP’s archives.

Composer and musician Paul Harrigan talks about the interactive learning resources he developed for ITMP.


Episode 2: Thursday 26th November 2026

Honoria Galwey (1830-1925) - a forgotten collector.

ITMP has since 2016, been exploring and developing the study of this important female collector who collected in and around Moville in the mid to late1800s.

In 2025 ITMP commissioned a documentary film Between Two Worlds - Honoria Galwey- A Portrait.

This film included historical research along with a new arrangement of tunes and songs from her collections. Also included was recently uncovered material, which was discovered during the research for the project.


Episode 4. 12th December 2026

Seamus Grant (1934-2005)

ITMP recorded Seamus’s one and only commercial recording.

ITMP’s archive holds a wealth of archive material relating to this important fiddler.

This episode will explore Seamus’s legacy as a fiddle player through interviews with musicians who played with Seamus and an overall perspective on his position within the tradition.


Episode 4. 23rd December 2026

Dinny McLaughlin (1935-2004)

ITMP worked with this noted musician, composer, poet and choreographer on many projects over the years prior to his death.

He was the main focus of Féile na hInse 2026 which took place in April.

This episode will explore the wealth of material that ITMP holds relating to Dinny from recordings, stories, poetry and photographs. It has a substantial collection of material shot during the production of the documentary Ark of Tides (2013) which it would like to make available to the public.


This series is produced and presented by Neil McGrory, Macruari Audio and Film.

title: Quran Experts
author: Quran Experts
description:
Quran Experts is an online Quran academy dedicated to helping kids and adults around the world learn the Holy Quran from the comfort of their homes. Our mission is to make Quran learning easy, flexible and accessible for every Muslim family, wherever they live. 
Our qualified and caring tutors teach in live one-on-one sessions, so every student gets full attention and learns at their own pace. Class timings are flexible and fit easily into school, work and family routines.
We focus on correct Quran reading with Tajweed, memorization of the Holy Quran, and a deeper understanding of its message through Tafseer and Quranic Arabic.

title: A Day in the Life with Joy R'zelle
author: Joy R'zelle
description: A Day in the Life invites listeners into authentic conversations with professionals who speak openly about their career journeys, personal growth, and the realities of their roles. Each episode features an interview with a professional who breaks down what their job involves, how they got there, what skills matter most, and what candidates often get wrong. It’s a space designed to broaden your understanding of career possibilities, highlight your transferable strengths, and help you avoid the pitfalls that often hold people back.

description: Meet the change makers doing things differently: the coaches, creators and founders winning on the human stuff while everyone else automates themselves into oblivion. title: On Art, with Doug Thomas
author: Doug Thomas
description: In this podcast series, I discuss all things related to art and specifically music; from chats and discussions on my written articles to explaining my creative processes and philosophy.
